description: Smoke task for macfuse_env: pre_task verifies the macFUSE bundle exists at /Library/Filesystems/macfuse.fs/ with a readable version and the userspace mount helper installed. macFUSE is a filesystem framework (not a GUI app), so 'launching' here means the bundle is on disk and queryable via `defaults read`. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (pre_start downloaded + installed the .pkg, the bundle materialized at the expected path).
natural_language: Wait. macFUSE is installed before the agent gets control; no action is required.
